serializedLocalizedConversation.mainText:
Policeman: Let’s get out of here, this place gives me the creeps! Wasn’t that girl from two weeks ago brutally you-know-what and then you-know-what with a broken glass bottle in this exact place?
Policewoman: Listen, I’m not gonna hold your hand if that’s what you are asking me. 
They left…
I got away scot-free this time, but it was close. Too close.
Let’s better get going before they change their minds.
